description: CSUTLDTC, the called date-validation subprogram, invoked as the @Service it became. LS-DATE='2023-02-29' and LS-DATE-FORMAT='YYYY-MM-DD' are this case's two LINKAGE SECTION parameters (L84-L85); LS-RESULT PIC X(80) (L86) is the output and is asserted below as the single WS_MESSAGE_80 line. This program opens no file and is reached by no JCL, so it seeds no dataset, writes no record and takes no job parameter - its entire observable behaviour is the 80 bytes L97 moves into LS-RESULT and the severity L98 moves into RETURN-CODE. Expected values are STATICALLY DERIVED from the 01 WS-MESSAGE declaration at L42-L57 and the group move at L122, never captured from a COBOL run, which is impossible here. Arm 3: FC-BAD-DATE-VALUE, 88-level VALUE X'000309CC59C3C5C5' (L64) - severity 3, message 2508. Reached with 29 February in a COMMON year, the case IBM itself uses to illustrate the condition. 2023 is not divisible by four, so February is 28 days long. Every field is numeric and in range on its own; only the combination is impossible, which is what distinguishes 2508 from 2517 and 2520.
